findings.finding: The production runner seal omitted Docker container Id, so an exact-config replacement object had the same digest and could be quiesced, started or retired as though it were the object created before durable intent.
findings.required_remediation: Bind the seal to the exact Docker object identity and bounded execution configuration, and dynamically prove an exact-config replacement object is rejected.

findings.finding: Terminal MIGRATED, ACTIVATED and ROLLED_BACK states were written before their terminal audit append, while ALREADY paths did not reconcile a crash between those operations.
findings.required_remediation: Persist a deterministic terminal audit receipt with terminal state, reconcile its exact audit record idempotently at every relevant entry, reject duplicates or drift, and cover the exact post-state/pre-audit crash window.
